item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately assigns specified presidential functions to the Secretary of State, subject to consultation; this is an internal delegation, while any legal consequences arise only from later exercise of those functions.","evidence":"I hereby delegate to the Secretary of State the functions vested in the President"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately delegates specified statutory functions to the Secretary of State without directing any particular later legal outcome.","evidence":"I hereby delegate to the Secretary of State the functions vested in the President"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately assigns Treasury authority to exercise specified sanctions-related functions when the stated prerequisite is met, but does not itself select or impose a sanction.","evidence":"I hereby delegate to the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State, the functions vested in the President"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The President preserves an earlier internal delegation arrangement for implementing the prior statutory provisions; the segment does not itself impose a substantive legal consequence.","evidence":"shall remain in effect with regard to implementation under section 102(h)(2) of CISADA"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately distributes statutory functions among executive officials and defines the memorandum’s future statutory references, without compelling a specified exercise of those functions or itself granting waivers, imposing sanctions, or applying prohibitions.","evidence":"I hereby delegate functions vested in the President by CISADA"}]}
